<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>CELL47 ESPORTS</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@300;400;600;700;800;900&family=Rajdhani:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --black:#03050a;
  --navy:#040d1e;
  --deep:#071428;
  --mid:#0a1d3d;
  --blue:#1a4a8a;
  --bright:#2a7fff;
  --cyan:#00d4ff;
  --teal:#00f0c8;
  --glow:rgba(0,212,255,0.35);
  --glow2:rgba(42,127,255,0.25);
  --glass:rgba(10,29,61,0.45);
  --glass2:rgba(0,212,255,0.06);
  --border:rgba(0,212,255,0.18);
  --border2:rgba(42,127,255,0.2);
  --white:#eef4ff;
  --muted:rgba(200,220,255,0.5);
  --f-head:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;
  --f-body:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;
  --f-mono:'Share Tech Mono',monospace;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;overflow-x:hidden}
body{background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-family:var(--f-body);cursor:none;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}

/* CURSOR */
#cur{position:fixed;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;top:0;left:0}
#cur-ring{position:absolute;width:32px;height:32px;border:1.5px solid var(--cyan);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .2s,height .2s,border-color .2s;opacity:.7}
#cur-dot{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--cyan);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan)}
body:has(a:hover) #cur-ring,body:has(button:hover) #cur-ring,body:has(.hov:hover) #cur-ring{width:56px;height:56px;border-color:var(--teal)}

/* SCROLLBAR */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--navy)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--bright);border-radius:2px}

/* NAV */
nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 64px;height:76px;
  transition:all .4s
}
nav.solid{
  background:rgba(3,5,10,0.88);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)
}
.nav-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none}
.nav-logo img{height:44px;width:auto;mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:brightness(1.15) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(0,212,255,.5))}
.nav-logo-text{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.35em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.3}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:36px;list-style:none;align-items:center}
.nav-links a{
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;
  color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;
  transition:color .2s;position:relative
}
.nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-3px;left:0;width:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--cyan),var(--teal));transition:width .3s}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--cyan)}
.nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%}
.nav-cta{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--black);text-decoration:none;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),var(--teal));
  padding:10px 28px;
  transition:all .25s;
  box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,212,255,.3)
}
.nav-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(0,212,255,.5)}

/* HERO */
#hero{
  position:relative;width:100vw;height:100vh;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden
}
.hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0}

/* Animated smoke/nebula layers */
.smoke-layer{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 80% at 50% 60%, rgba(26,74,138,0.4) 0%, rgba(0,18,42,0.7) 40%, transparent 70%);
  animation:smokeDrift 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate
}
.smoke-layer:nth-child(2){
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 100% at 20% 30%, rgba(0,212,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%);
  animation:smokeDrift2 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate
}
.smoke-layer:nth-child(3){
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 80% 70%, rgba(42,127,255,0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
  animation:smokeDrift 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse
}
@keyframes smokeDrift{0%{transform:scale(1) translate(0,0)}100%{transform:scale(1.08) translate(20px,-15px)}}
@keyframes smokeDrift2{0%{transform:scale(1) translate(0,0)}100%{transform:scale(1.05) translate(-25px,20px)}}

.hero-grid-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(0,212,255,.03) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,212,255,.03) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:70px 70px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 50%, black 20%, transparent 70%)
}

/* Hero canvas for particles */
#hero-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1}

.hero-inner{
  position:relative;z-index:5;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  align-items:center;gap:0;
  width:100%;max-width:1400px;padding:0 64px;
  margin-top:76px
}

/* Left text block */
.hero-left{padding-right:40px}
.hero-org{
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5em;
  color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s .3s forwards
}
.hero-org::before{content:'';width:24px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--cyan),transparent)}
.hero-title{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(64px,7vw,108px);
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:.92;
  margin-bottom:24px;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .8s .5s forwards
}
.hero-title .t1{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,#b0d0ff 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent
}
.hero-title .t2{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan) 0%,var(--teal) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(0,212,255,.4))
}
.hero-sub{
  font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:15px;font-weight:400;
  color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;letter-spacing:.04em;
  max-width:340px;margin-bottom:44px;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s .7s forwards
}
.hero-btns{
  display:flex;gap:14px;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s .9s forwards
}
.btn-p{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--black);text-decoration:none;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),var(--teal));
  padding:14px 34px;
  transition:all .25s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(0,212,255,.35)
}
.btn-p:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 36px rgba(0,212,255,.5)}
.btn-s{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none;
  background:var(--glass);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:13px 34px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  transition:all .25s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px
}
.btn-s:hover{background:rgba(0,212,255,.12);border-color:var(--cyan);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* Hero center — logo big */

@keyframes scaleIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.85)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}

50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 60px rgba(0,212,255,.9)) drop-shadow(0 0 120px rgba(0,212,255,.4))}}

/* Hero right stats */
.hero-right{
  padding-left:40px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .7s 1s forwards
}
.hero-stat-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;
  background:var(--glass);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  padding:18px 24px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:background .2s
}
.hero-stat-row::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--cyan),var(--teal))}
.hero-stat-row:hover{background:rgba(0,212,255,.1)}
.h-sv{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:34px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--white);min-width:90px;line-height:1}
.h-sv span{color:var(--cyan);font-size:22px}
.h-sl{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.4}

/* Hero bottom bar */
.hero-bar{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:5;
  display:flex;
  background:rgba(3,5,10,.6);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .7s 1.2s forwards
}
.hb-item{
  flex:1;padding:18px 32px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  cursor:none;transition:background .2s
}
.hb-item:last-child{border-right:none}
.hb-item:hover{background:rgba(0,212,255,.05)}
.hb-n{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.hb-v{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);letter-spacing:.04em}
.hb-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan);flex-shrink:0;animation:blink 2s infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}

@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}

/* SECTION WRAPPER */
.sec{position:relative;z-index:10}
.sec-inner{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto}

/* SECTION HEADER */
.sec-head{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;
  margin-bottom:72px;padding-bottom:28px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)
}
.sec-num{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;padding-bottom:4px}
.sec-title{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(44px,5vw,72px);
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:.95;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,#aac8ff 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent
}
.sec-title span{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),var(--teal));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent
}
.sec-rule{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--border),transparent);margin-bottom:4px}
.sec-tag{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;padding-bottom:4px}

/* Reveal */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.rv.on{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.d1{transition-delay:.08s}.d2{transition-delay:.16s}.d3{transition-delay:.24s}.d4{transition-delay:.32s}.d5{transition-delay:.4s}.d6{transition-delay:.5s}

/* ROSTER SECTION */
#roster{
  padding:130px 64px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--black) 0%, var(--navy) 50%, var(--black) 100%)
}

.roster-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);
  gap:3px
}

.p-card{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  aspect-ratio:.75;
  cursor:none;
  background:var(--deep);
  transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
}
.p-card:hover{transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.02);z-index:5}

.p-img{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;object-position:top center;
  transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  filter:brightness(.85) saturate(1.1)
}
.p-card:hover .p-img{transform:scale(1.06)}

/* Blue glow overlay */
.p-glow{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 60% at 50% 100%, rgba(0,212,255,.15) 0%, transparent 60%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s
}
.p-card:hover .p-glow{opacity:1}

/* Bottom gradient */
.p-fade{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(to top,
    rgba(4,13,30,.98) 0%,
    rgba(4,13,30,.8) 25%,
    rgba(4,13,30,.3) 55%,
    transparent 75%
  )
}

/* Glass info panel */
.p-info{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;
  padding:0 20px 24px;
  z-index:3
}
.p-role{
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.4em;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px
}
.p-name{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em;
  color:var(--white);line-height:1;margin-bottom:4px
}
.p-tag{
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;
  color:rgba(150,180,255,.4);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);
  transition:all .3s .05s
}
.p-card:hover .p-tag{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.p-cta-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.25em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);
  margin-top:10px;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:all .3s .08s
}
.p-cta-row::before{content:'';width:16px;height:1px;background:var(--cyan)}
.p-card:hover .p-cta-row{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* Side accent line */
.p-line{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:0;height:2px;
  transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  z-index:4
}
.p-card:hover .p-line{width:100%}

/* Player number */
.p-num{
  position:absolute;top:16px;right:16px;z-index:3;
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;
  color:rgba(0,212,255,.3);
  transition:color .3s
}
.p-card:hover .p-num{color:var(--cyan)}

/* Glass border on hover */
.p-border{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:border-color .3s;pointer-events:none;z-index:4
}
.p-card:hover .p-border{border-color:rgba(0,212,255,.25)}

/* MODAL */
#modal{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:5000;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .35s;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:32px
}
#modal.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.m-backdrop{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:rgba(3,5,10,.85);
  backdrop-filter:blur(24px)
}

/* Smoke in modal bg */
.m-smoke{
  position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden
}
.m-smoke::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 30% 40%, rgba(0,212,255,.06) 0%, transparent 60%),
             radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 70% 60%, rgba(42,127,255,.05) 0%, transparent 50%)
}

.m-box{
  position:relative;z-index:1;
  width:100%;max-width:1000px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(7,20,40,.92),rgba(4,13,30,.98));
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(0,212,255,.1),0 0 160px rgba(0,212,255,.05);
  transform:translateY(28px) scale(.97);
  transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
}
#modal.open .m-box{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}

.m-left{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:560px}
.m-left-img{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;object-position:top center;
  filter:brightness(.8) saturate(1.15)
}
.m-left-glow{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% 100%, rgba(0,212,255,.2) 0%, transparent 60%)
}
.m-left-fade{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(to right, transparent 60%, rgba(4,13,30,.8) 100%),
             linear-gradient(to top, rgba(4,13,30,.9) 0%, transparent 40%)
}

.m-right{
  padding:56px 48px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:center
}
.m-number{
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.45em;
  color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:12px
}
.m-role{
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.35em;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px
}
.m-name{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(52px,5.5vw,76px);
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;line-height:.9;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#b0d0ff);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
  margin-bottom:28px
}
.m-div{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--border),transparent);margin-bottom:28px}
.m-quote{
  font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:14px;font-weight:400;
  font-style:italic;color:rgba(180,210,255,.6);line-height:1.8;
  border-left:2px solid var(--cyan);padding-left:16px;
  margin-bottom:36px
}
.m-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;margin-bottom:36px}
.m-stat{
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  padding:16px 18px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  transition:background .2s
}
.m-stat:hover{background:rgba(0,212,255,.1)}
.m-sv{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:30px;font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1;margin-bottom:3px
}
.m-sl{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.m-close{
  position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;
  width:42px;height:42px;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  color:var(--muted);cursor:none;font-size:16px;font-family:var(--f-mono);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:all .2s
}
.m-close:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--white);background:rgba(0,212,255,.12)}

/* JERSEY SECTION */
#jersey{
  padding:0;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--black),var(--navy),var(--black));
  position:relative;overflow:hidden
}
.jersey-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 80% at 50% 50%, rgba(0,212,255,.06) 0%, transparent 60%)
}
.jersey-inner{
  max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  align-items:center;min-height:700px;
  padding:100px 64px
}
.jersey-left{position:relative}
.jersey-img{
  width:100%;max-width:600px;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(0,212,255,.3)) drop-shadow(0 0 80px rgba(42,127,255,.15));
  animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite
}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-16px)}}
.jersey-right{padding-left:60px}
.jersey-label{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px}
.jersey-title{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(44px,4.5vw,68px);
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.03em;line-height:.95;
  margin-bottom:24px
}
.jersey-title .j1{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#aac8ff);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent
}
.jersey-title .j2{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),var(--teal));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent
}
.jersey-sub{
  font-size:15px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);
  line-height:1.75;letter-spacing:.03em;max-width:380px;margin-bottom:40px
}
.jersey-badges{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:40px}
.badge{
  font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--cyan);border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  padding:8px 16px
}

/* MANIFESTO STRIP */
#manifesto{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  padding:100px 64px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--deep) 0%,var(--mid) 50%,var(--deep) 100%)
}
.manifesto-glow{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 70% at 50% 50%, rgba(0,212,255,.07) 0%, transparent 60%)
}
.manifesto-grid{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(0,212,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,212,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:60px 60px
}
.manifesto-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.m-big{
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(52px,6vw,88px);
  font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:.95
}
.m-big .l1{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan) 0%,var(--teal) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent
}
.m-big .l2{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,#8ab4ff 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent
}
.m-right-content{padding:8px 0}
.m-label{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px}
.m-text{font-size:15px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.85;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-bottom:32px}
.m-pillars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.m-pillar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);padding:14px 20px
}
.m-pillar-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),var(--teal));flex-shrink:0}
.m-pillar-text{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--white);text-transform:uppercase}

/* HIGHLIGHTS */
#highlights{
  padding:130px 64px;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--black),var(--navy) 50%,var(--black))
}
.hl-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  gap:3px;
  height:640px
}
.hl-card{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:none;
  background:var(--deep);
  transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
}
.hl-card:hover{z-index:3;transform:scale(1.01)}
.hl-card.span2{grid-row:span 2}
.hl-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden
}
.hl-bg-canvas{width:100%;height:100%}
.hl-fade{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(4,13,30,.97) 0%,rgba(4,13,30,.4) 50%,transparent 80%)
}
.hl-play{
  position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.8);
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(0,212,255,.4);
  background:rgba(0,212,255,.08);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;transition:all .3s
}
.hl-play::after{content:'';width:0;height:0;border-style:solid;border-width:8px 0 8px 15px;border-color:transparent transparent transparent var(--white);margin-left:3px}
.hl-card:hover .hl-play{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}
.hl-info{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:22px 24px;z-index:2}
.hl-tag{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.35em;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.hl-title{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(16px,1.8vw,22px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--white);line-height:1.15;margin-bottom:6px}
.hl-card.span2 .hl-title{font-size:clamp(22px,2.5vw,32px)}
.hl-meta{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:rgba(150,180,255,.5)}
.hl-vline{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:2px;height:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--cyan),var(--teal));transition:height .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hl-card:hover .hl-vline{height:100%}

/* SPONSORS */
#sponsors{
  padding:130px 64px;
  background:var(--black);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border)
}
.sp-row{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);
  gap:3px;margin-bottom:3px
}
.sp-cell{
  background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  padding:36px 24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  cursor:none;transition:all .25s;position:relative;overflow:hidden
}
.sp-cell::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,212,255,.04),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s}
.sp-cell:hover::before{opacity:1}
.sp-cell:hover{border-color:rgba(0,212,255,.35);background:rgba(0,212,255,.06)}
.sp-name{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:18px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.25em;color:rgba(200,220,255,.18);transition:color .25s;text-transform:uppercase}
.sp-cell:hover .sp-name{color:rgba(200,220,255,.5)}

.sp-cta{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--glass),rgba(0,212,255,.04));
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  padding:80px 80px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;
  gap:60px;align-items:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden
}
.sp-cta::before{
  content:'C47';
  position:absolute;right:60px;bottom:-30px;
  font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(100px,12vw,180px);
  color:rgba(0,212,255,.04);letter-spacing:.05em;
  pointer-events:none;line-height:1
}
.sp-cta-smoke{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 80% 50%, rgba(0,212,255,.04) 0%, transparent 60%)
}
.sp-label{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:16px}
.sp-title{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:clamp(38px,4vw,60px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.03em;line-height:.97;margin-bottom:16px}
.sp-title .st1{display:block;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#aac8ff);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.sp-title .st2{display:block;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),var(--teal));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.sp-sub{font-size:15px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;letter-spacing:.03em;max-width:460px}
.sp-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.sp-mail{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center}

/* FOOTER */
footer{
  background:var(--navy);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:40px 64px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px
}
.f-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.f-logo img{height:36px;mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:brightness(1.15) drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(0,212,255,.4))}
.f-logo-name{font-family:var(--f-head);font-size:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--muted)}
.f-links{display:flex;gap:24px;list-style:none}
.f-links a{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.25em;color:rgba(150,180,255,.4);text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .2s}
.f-links a:hover{color:var(--cyan)}
.f-copy{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:rgba(150,180,255,.2);text-transform:uppercase}

@media(max-width:1100px){
  nav{padding:0 32px}
  .nav-links{gap:20px}
  #hero,#roster,#jersey,#manifesto,#highlights,#sponsors{padding-left:32px;padding-right:32px}
  .hero-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:0 32px;text-align:center}
  .hero-right{display:none}
  .hero-org,.hero-sub{justify-content:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
  .hero-btns{justify-content:center}
  .roster-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .jersey-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .jersey-right{padding-left:0;padding-top:40px}
  .manifesto-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hl-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;height:auto}
  .hl-card.span2{grid-row:1;aspect-ratio:16/9}
  .sp-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .sp-cta{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:48px 40px}
  footer{flex-direction:column;padding:32px;gap:16px;text-align:center}
  .f-links{justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
}
</style>
</head>

<script>
/* CURSOR */
const ring=document.getElementById('cur-ring'),dot=document.getElementById('cur-dot');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;dot.style.left=mx+'px';dot.style.top=my+'px'});
(function loop(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.1;ry+=(my-ry)*.1;ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';requestAnimationFrame(loop)})();

/* NAV SCROLL */
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>document.getElementById('nav').classList.toggle('solid',scrollY>60));

/* HERO PARTICLES */
(function(){
  const c=document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  function sz(){c.width=innerWidth;c.height=innerHeight}
  sz();addEventListener('resize',sz);
  const N=60;
  const pts=Array.from({length:N},()=>({x:Math.random()*c.width,y:Math.random()*c.height,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.3,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.3}));
  function frame(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
    pts.forEach(p=>{
      p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
      if(p.x<0||p.x>c.width)p.vx*=-1;
      if(p.y<0||p.y>c.height)p.vy*=-1;
    });
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<N;j++){
      const d=Math.hypot(pts[i].x-pts[j].x,pts[i].y-pts[j].y);
      if(d<140){
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,212,255,'+(1-d/140)*.06+')';
        ctx.lineWidth=.6;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x,pts[i].y);ctx.lineTo(pts[j].x,pts[j].y);ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    pts.forEach(p=>{
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,212,255,.14)';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,1,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  frame();
})();

/* HIGHLIGHT CANVASES */
const hlColors=[
  ['#1a3a7a','#0090cc','#00d4ff'],
  ['#1a3a7a','#00c4ff','#0050aa'],
  ['#2a1a4a','#6040cc','#00a4ff'],
  ['#0a2a3a','#00c4aa','#0080cc'],
  ['#3a1a1a','#cc4040','#ff6030'],
];
function drawHl(id,colors){
  const c=document.getElementById(id);if(!c)return;
  const W=c.width=c.offsetWidth,H=c.height=c.offsetHeight;if(!W||!H)return;
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle=colors[0];ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.4,H*.3,0,W*.4,H*.3,W*.8);
  g.addColorStop(0,colors[1]+'44');g.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.strokeStyle=colors[2]+'15';ctx.lineWidth=.5;
  for(let x=0;x<W;x+=35){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,H);ctx.stroke()}
  for(let y=0;y<H;y+=35){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.stroke()}
  const g2=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,H);
  g2.addColorStop(0,colors[2]+'08');g2.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=g2;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const d=ctx.createLinearGradient(W*.3,0,W*.6,H);
  d.addColorStop(0,'transparent');d.addColorStop(.5,colors[2]+'12');d.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=d;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
}
function initHl(){
  ['hc0','hc1','hc2','hc3','hc4'].forEach((id,i)=>{
    drawHl(id,hlColors[i]);
    new ResizeObserver(()=>drawHl(id,hlColors[i])).observe(document.getElementById(id).parentElement);
  });
}
addEventListener('load',initHl);

/* PLAYER DATA */
const imgGaara='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
const imgPeanut='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
const imgGrave='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
const imgAmrit='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
const imgAditya='data:image/jpeg;base64,';

const players=[
  {n:'01',role:'IGL · In-Game Leader',rColor:'var(--cyan)',name:'ADITYA',img:imgAditya,
   quote:'"Leading with vision. Winning with purpose. Every call I make has one goal — the win."',
   stats:[{v:'1.72',l:'K/D Ratio'},{v:'96%',l:'Call Accuracy'},{v:'IGL',l:'Role'},{v:'3.2K',l:'Hrs Played'}]},
  {n:'02',role:'Assaulter · Entry',rColor:'#ff6040',name:'GAARA',img:imgGaara,
   quote:'"Always there. Always assaulting. Always the difference. Support. Adapt. Empower."',
   stats:[{v:'2.3',l:'K/D Ratio'},{v:'87%',l:'Entry Success'},{v:'Top 5',l:'India Rank'},{v:'2.8K',l:'Hrs Played'}]},
  {n:'03',role:'Assaulter · Fragger',rColor:'#ffaa40',name:'PEANUT',img:imgPeanut,
   quote:'"Aggressive by nature. Fearless by choice. Built to dominate. Attack. Pressure. Destroy."',
   stats:[{v:'2.6',l:'K/D Ratio'},{v:'91%',l:'Entry Win Rate'},{v:'Top 3',l:'India Rank'},{v:'3.0K',l:'Hrs Played'}]},
  {n:'04',role:'Assaulter · Fragger',rColor:'#60c8ff',name:'GRAVE',img:imgGrave,
   quote:'"Aggressive by nature. Fearless by choice. Built to dominate. Attack. Pressure. Destroy."',
   stats:[{v:'2.4',l:'K/D Ratio'},{v:'88%',l:'Entry Win Rate'},{v:'Top 8',l:'India Rank'},{v:'2.9K',l:'Hrs Played'}]},
  {n:'05',role:'Support',rColor:'var(--teal)',name:'AMRIT',img:imgAmrit,
   quote:'"Always there. Always supporting. Always the difference. Support. Adapt. Empower."',
   stats:[{v:'1.5',l:'K/D Ratio'},{v:'99%',l:'Util Efficiency'},{v:'Best',l:'Support India'},{v:'3.1K',l:'Hrs Played'}]},
];

function openModal(i){
  const p=players[i];
  document.getElementById('m-img').src=p.img;
  document.getElementById('m-number').textContent='Player '+p.n;
  document.getElementById('m-role').textContent=p.role;
  document.getElementById('m-role').style.color=p.rColor;
  document.getElementById('m-name').textContent=p.name;
  document.getElementById('m-quote').textContent=p.quote;
  document.getElementById('m-stats').innerHTML=p.stats.map(s=>'<div class="m-stat"><div class="m-sv" style="color:'+p.rColor+'">'+s.v+'</div><div class="m-sl">'+s.l+'</div></div>').join('');
  document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
}
function closeModal(){
  document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeModal()});

/* REVEAL */
new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('on')}),{threshold:.06})
  .observe && (() => {
    const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('on')}),{threshold:.06});
    document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
  })();

/* ANCHOR */
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const t=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
  if(t){e.preventDefault();t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}
}));

/* SOUND */
let ac;
function tone(f,d,v){try{if(!ac)ac=new(AudioContext||webkitAudioContext)();const o=ac.createOscillator(),g=ac.createGain();o.connect(g);g.connect(ac.destination);o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,ac.currentTime);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f*.3,ac.currentTime+d);g.gain.setValueAtTime(v,ac.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,ac.currentTime+d);o.start();o.stop(ac.currentTime+d)}catch(e){}}
document.querySelectorAll('a,button,.p-card,.hl-card,.sp-cell').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>tone(900,.02,.02));
  el.addEventListener('click',()=>tone(600,.06,.06));
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
